name: GMAI-MMBench
intro: GMAI-MMBench是一个全面的通用医疗AI基准，旨在评估大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）在各种医疗应用中的有效性。该基准解决了现有基准在临床相关性、评估不完整性和交互式LVLMs指导不足等方面的局限性。它由284个数据集构建，涵盖38种医学图像模态、18项临床相关任务、18个科室和4种感知粒度，采用视觉问答（VQA）形式。
org: Shanghai AI Laboratory, University of Washington, Monash University, East China Normal University, U
intro_en: GMAI-MMBench is a comprehensive general medical AI benchmark designed to evaluate the effectiveness of large vision-language models (LVLMs) across various medical applications. It addresses limitations of existing benchmarks in clinical relevance, incomplete evaluation, and insufficient guidance for interactive LVLMs. The benchmark is built from 284 datasets, covering 38 medical image modalities, 18 clinically relevant tasks, 18 departments, and 4 levels of perceptual granularity, using a visual question answering (VQA) format.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2408.03361. GMAI-MMBench is built from 284 public and hospital medical datasets covering 38 image modalities. The construction pipeline first filters high-quality labels, standardizes 2D/3D medical images into 2D RGB images, and normalizes labels with MeSH-style uniqueness and ambiguity checks. Labels are organized into a lexical tree across 18 clinical VQA tasks, 18 departments, modalities, and four perceptual granularities. Biomedical annotators tag labels, then GPT-4o generates question templates and option pools requiring modality, clinical-task cue, and granularity information. Questions are manually reviewed to remove non-image-answerable or malformed cases, and cases are balanced into roughly 26K VQA questions. Evaluation uses LVLM zero-shot answer selection/extraction and reports macro-averaged accuracy, plus multiple-choice accuracy/recall where relevant.
